nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context ignore rules for the Pixelle-Video image. Excludes Python build artifacts (__pycache__, *.pyc, dist/, egg-info), virtualenvs (.venv, venv), IDE files (.vscode, .idea), git metadata (.git), most docs (*.md except README.md), plans/repositories/examples dirs, tests, logs, output/* and temp files, user data (data/users/*), local config.yaml files, and macOS junk (.DS_Store). Explicitly keeps docs/images, docs/FAQ*.md, README.md, output/.gitkeep, data/.gitkeep, and config.example.yaml so only source needed for the image build enters the build context.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for Pixelle-Video. Stage 1 (node:22-alpine, 'frontend-builder') runs npm ci and npm run build to produce the React frontend bundle. Stage 2 (python:3.11-slim) installs system deps (curl, ffmpeg, fonts-noto-cjk for CJK rendering), installs the uv package manager, creates a venv, pip-installs the Python package in editable mode (copying pyproject.toml, uv.lock, README.md and the pixelle_video package first so hatchling can build), installs Playwright Chromium, copies api/, bgm/, templates/, workflows/, resources/, docs/ and the frontend dist output, creates /app/output, /app/data, /app/temp, EXPOSEs port 8000, and defaults to CMD ['uv', 'run', 'python', 'api/app.py']. Supports ARG USE_CN_MIRROR=true to swap apt sources to Aliyun and pip to the Tsinghua mirror for China deployments.

nodes.name: frontend-builder (build stage)
nodes.summary: Build stage of the Dockerfile based on node:22-alpine: copies frontend/package.json and package-lock.json, installs exact dependencies with npm ci, copies the frontend source, and runs npm run build. Its dist output is later copied into the final Python image via COPY --from=frontend-builder.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose orchestration for Pixelle-Video defining the bridge network 'pixelle-network' and two services: 'init' (one-shot alpine container that fixes a mis-mounted config.yaml directory and creates config.yaml from config.example.yaml if missing) and 'api' (pixelle-video-api, built from ./Dockerfile with USE_CN_MIRROR passthrough, published on 127.0.0.1:8000, mounting ./config.yaml, ./data and ./output for persistence, curl healthcheck on /health, TZ=Asia/Shanghai, restart unless-stopped, 10MB/3-file json-file log rotation). The api service only starts after init completes successfully.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: One-shot bootstrap service (image alpine:latest, restart: no) that mounts the project directory at /workspace and, via a shell command: removes config.yaml if Docker mounted it as a directory (fixes the 'mounting a non-existent file creates a directory' issue), then copies config.example.yaml to config.yaml when the file is absent. The api service declares depends_on with condition service_completed_successfully, so config.yaml is guaranteed to exist before the API starts.

nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Main backend service (container_name pixelle-video-api) built from the repo's Dockerfile with USE_CN_MIRROR=${USE_CN_MIRROR:-false}. Runs '.venv/bin/python api/app.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000', publishes 127.0.0.1:8000:8000 (localhost-only), mounts ./config.yaml (read-write so the Web UI can save settings), ./data and ./output for persistence, sets TZ=Asia/Shanghai, healthchecks http://localhost:8000/health with curl every 30s (10s timeout, 3 retries, 10s start period), restarts unless-stopped with rotated json-file logs, and joins the pixelle-network bridge.
